summary: MIGRATION VERIFIED END-TO-END - CMS writes reach the customer app. Real Playwright/Chromium against production HTTPS URLs (admin.pizzadenfert.fr + pizzadenfert.fr). TEST 1 (CMS write -> customer read): logged into CMS as admin@pizzadenfert.fr, edited pizza 'Margherita test' to 'E2E_MIGRATION_OK_1782953526', PATCH went to https://fuxyinngmdzzoumloenv.supabase.co/rest/v1/menu_items?id=eq.4c209fad-... returning 204 (frontend uses Prefer:return=minimal, so 204 with empty body = success; write confirmed by dashboard refresh + customer app render). Opened https://pizzadenfert.fr in a fresh context, tapped Menu tab, and the customer 'La Carte' screen shows E2E_MIGRATION_OK_1782953526 as the first Pizzas item (screenshot 10). Reverted the name back to 'Margherita test' via the same UI flow - PATCH again went to new project (204); customer app immediately reflects the revert (screenshot 13). ZERO requests to the old project vgpkxuwcvpkdqgpxnhlu.supabase.co observed in either admin or customer context; ALL Supabase traffic hits fuxyinngmdzzoumloenv.supabase.co. TEST 2 (reservation flow regression): submitted a reservation from https://pizzadenfert.fr/reserve as MIG_TEST_RES_1782953726, phone +33600000199, 3 convives, Intérieur, 20:00. POST /api/reservations/guest returned 200 and the confirmation screen 'Réservation confirmée' appeared. Logged into admin (email/password flow at admin.pizzadenfert.fr/admin) and navigated to /admin-reservations - the reservation is visible with status 'Confirmée'. Clicked cancel-b371ede2-3e0c-4c07-b068-ffb73c4a23ce and status flipped to 'Annulée' (screenshot 39). FINAL VERDICT: MIGRATION VERIFIED END-TO-END - CMS writes reach the customer app.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: authenticated PATCH from CMS returned 200 with body '[]' because RLS write policies on the previous Supabase project did not match the auth.uid() -> admins.user_id lookup. New project has policy `admins_can_write: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admins WHERE user_id = auth.uid())` which passes when the logged-in user 37f06ebf-3a4d-4dd7-8509-1f5168e8ddb6 is present in admins. Verified live: PATCH now returns 204 (minimal) and the underlying row is updated, as proven by both dashboard reload and independent customer-app render.
